info.name: Pharma-DMS Phase 1 - All Completed APIs
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for all Phase 1 APIs:

**1.1 Authentication & Identity** – Login, Refresh, Logout, Forgot/Reset Password, Me, Roles, Departments, Navigation
**1.2 Dashboards & Navigation** – Request Counts, Recent Requests, Recent Templates, KPIs
**1.3 Templates & AI-Assisted Document Preparation** – Upload, List, Get, Download URL, Update, Approve, Versions, Delete

**Setup:**
1. Set baseUrl (default: http://localhost:4000)
2. Run Health Check, then Login to get accessToken
3. Tokens and templateId are auto-saved

**Demo Users:** sarah.admin@company.com, john.requestor@company.com, robert.manager@company.com, patricia.approver@company.com (password: demo123)

// Note: Postman will handle multipart/form-data automatically

// Save template ID for subsequent requests

formdata.description: Upload a Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), or PDF (.pdf) file. Max size: 50MB
Optional: Display name for the template

request.description:
Upload a template file to AWS S3 and create a template record.

**Request:**
- Method: POST
- Content-Type: multipart/form-data
- Field name: `file` (required)
- Optional fields: `name`, `description`, `departmentId`, `organizationId`

**Response:**
- Returns template metadata with `id`, `name`, `fileSize`, `status: 'draft'`
- File is stored in S3 at: `Pharma+DMS/templates/{templateId}/v1/{filename}`

request.description:
Update template metadata (name, description, parsed sections, form schema, AI workflow proposal, status).

**Note:** File updates require creating a new version. This endpoint only updates metadata.

**Request Body (all fields optional):**
- `name`: Template display name
- `description`: Template description
- `parsedSections`: AI-extracted sections (JSON)
- `formSchema`: Form schema (JSON)
- `aiWorkflowProposal`: AI workflow proposal (JSON)
- `status`: Template status (draft, pending_approval, approved, deprecated)
